# Goal
Souji round 15 only. C1 operability FIRST: repair round-14 rejected-harmed value-blind Git config refusals while retaining all verified namespace gains. Preserve benign configurations and mixed fleets. C2 calibration (lowest legacy axis 7): independent preservation evidence admission checker rejects green-only, weakened or missing preservation evidence; paired red/green and namespace controls required. No certification or deletion authority.
# Contract
Lane absolute root /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/souji-shokunin/<that path>. All seats are leaves. No delegation, commits, tests, builds, linters, formatters, smoke runs, or empirical probes: SOURCE INSPECTION ONLY except writing assigned implementation. L1 alone executes final acceptance after all seats finish. Never open/copy/query/modify ~/.omp/agent/agent.db* or ANY real credential/auth file. Synthetic fixture paths only; never launch separate omp processes. OPERATOR-authored census/operator-sweep-20261019/ must not be opened, edited, moved, staged, copied or deleted. Never write fleet/sibling files, LOG/SCORECARD/QUALITY/SOURCES unless expressly assigned. Each seat owns only its report plus explicit assigned files. Message SoujiR15 only by id for findings/questions; never orchestrator or agent://all.
Tooling authorization: read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md before any helpful tool install/upgrade; record tool/version/channel/reason. ALL pacman transactions PAUSED host-wide: no pacman install/update/remove/downgrade, no host-service restart. Use uv tool/npx/official binary ~/.local/bin or L0. Do not inspect authentication config. Findings are advisory, never fabricate runtime evidence. Before code changes read applicable existing patterns. Reports concise with exact lines, actionable findings and unrun checks.

Falsify wave: wave1 artifacts now exist. Attack actual source, not stale concurrent absence. Every search/read must target explicit named files under lane tools/, tests/, census/round-15/, corpus/ or .ufo/waves/round-15/; NEVER query whole lane root or census recursively because it traverses the operator sweep. No runtime probes/tests even if tiny. Own only your absolute report. L1 executes final acceptance once after both waves. Distinguish actionable defects from design conjecture and report precise lines.
